The '''Quamar system''' was located in the [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] linked it to the [[Mugaar system/Legends|Mugaar system]] as well as the [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Yushan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Quamar [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Quamar Messenger]]''.<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Quamar system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
